details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The gold target is Donald Trump. Grover Cleveland is not the correct answer, so the prediction contradicts the target.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. Citation [5] identifies Trump as a Republican and says Grover Cleveland, a Democrat, was the only president to have served nonconsecutive terms up to that point.
2. Citation [10] states Trump became the second president to serve two non-consecutive terms after Cleveland.
3. Together, these passages establish that Trump was the first Republican president to serve non-consecutive terms.
